title: Single log line is 49KB+ (ext4) / 110KB+ (btrfs) of systemd-journald disk writes
summary: A performance issue report for systemd-journald where single log lines are causing unexpectedly large disk writes—49KB+ on ext4 and 110KB+ on btrfs filesystems, indicating inefficient journal logging behavior that wastes disk I/O and storage.
problem_solved: Reports and documents excessive disk write amplification in systemd's journal logging service when processing single log entries.
why_valuable: Helps Linux system administrators and developers understand and address journald's disk I/O overhead, which can impact storage performance and SSD lifespan.
